question.knowledge_point: Computing a Probability on a Bounded Interval
question.problem:
The data below is taken from the table of values of the cumulative distribution function $Φ(z)$ for the standard normal distribution. Given that $Z∼N(0,1),$ compute $P(-1.2
$z$$\,0.00\,$$\,0.01\,$$\,0.02\,$
$\,-1.2\,$ $\,0.1151\,$ $\,0.1131\,$ $\,0.1112\,$
$\,-1.1\,$ $\,0.1357\,$ $\,0.1335\,$ $\,0.1314\,$
$\,-1.0\,$ $\,0.1587\,$ $\,0.1562\,$ $\,0.1539\,$
$z$$\,0.00\,$$\,0.01\,$$\,0.02\,$
$\,-0.5\,$ $\,0.3085\,$ $\,0.3050\,$ $\,0.3015\,$

question.worked_solution:
We're given that $Z∼N(0,1),$ and we wish to compute $P(-1.2<Z<-0.31).$ The required probability is represented by the area shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14069404/assets/46b71217fcee1d130b3778ce2cd101aac9814870b71683656987d476e71412c1.png)

By the definition of the cumulative distribution function $Φ(z),$ 

$$
P(Z\le z)=Φ(z).
$$

So, we express the required probability in terms of $Φ(z)$:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(-1.2<Z<-0.31) & =P(Z<-0.31)-P(Z\le -1.2) \\  & =P(Z\le -0.31)-P(Z\le -1.2) \\  & =Φ(-0.31)-Φ(-1.2)\end{aligned}
$$

From the tables, we have the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}Φ(-1.2) & =0.1151 \\ Φ(-0.31) & =0.3783\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(-1.2<Z<-0.31) & =Φ(-0.31)-Φ(-1.2) \\  & =0.3783-0.1151 \\  & =0.2632.\end{aligned}
$$

In q-134529, the displayed expansion of (1+x)^6 ends with x^n instead of x^6; the approximation and percentage error are correct. Independently: q-94154 gives 1-0.9826=0.0174; q-131521 gives 0.1611-0.0233=0.1378; q-94194 gives 0.3783-0.1151=0.2632. Using P(X=k)=\binom{n}{k}p^k(1-p)^{n-k}, q-96728 gives 0.0256, q-97464 gives 0.27648→0.2765, q-97519 gives 0.4960116→0.4960, and q-97516 gives 0.098816→0.0988. For q-97521, 1-(0.5)^7=0.9921875→0.9922. For q-134529, the three-term approximation is 1-0.6+0.15=0.55; 100|0.55-0.531441|/0.531441 rounds to 3.49%. For q-134649, 1024+1280(-0.11)+640(-0.11)^2=890.944. For q-160776, substitution gives components 2e^0=2, sqrt(4)=2, and (-2)^4=16. For q-162704, the composed transformation is diag(-3,1), so a+b=-2. For q-89366, success means red or green, with probability 0.6; binom(12,5)(0.6)^5(0.4)^7 rounds to 0.101. For q-130744, summing the binomial probabilities for 6, 7, and 8 successes rounds to 0.0006. For q-84805, 1-[(0.8)^15+15(0.2)(0.8)^14+105(0.2)^2(0.8)^13] rounds to 0.602. For q-84804, 1-[(0.65)^14+14(0.35)(0.65)^13] rounds to 0.979. The source-error judgment concerns intermediate writing, with no disagreement on any requested final value.
